note: maib's tariffs and commissions for card servicing (last revision in force from 30 June 2026; read through the fetch tool since the server refuses curl): the maib daily general card account carries a monthly administration fee of 15 lei, nothing in a month with at least 3,000 lei of cashless payments, a condition the game doesn't track, so it's charged in full.

sources.said: TARIFELE ȘI COMISIOANELE PENTRU DESERVIREA CARDURILOR ultima redacție în vigoare din 30.06.2026 ...
